summary.text: Joe Flynn is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Brian Close (D).

paragraphs.text: Joe Flynn ran in the Republican primary for Montana House of Representatives District 63 on June 4, 2024, and Mark Lewis defeated him.
In 2026 he advanced from the Republican primary for District 65 on June 2.
